# Public native Read regression fixtures

These Apache-2.0 synthetic engineering fixtures contain authored preferences and explicit graph references. They contain no real person, private content, or human acceptance evidence. `seed.authored.json` is the inspectable source; the generator writes each complete authored variant and creates real native section containers with the fixed CLI runtime.

Run `node scripts/generate-native-fixtures.mjs EXACT_CLI_ENTRY` with CLI `0.39.0-rc.native-sections.3`. The six variants exercise optional expansion, required dependency closure, an authored method statement, an asset identity, a null declaration, and shared actor support deduplication. The truncated container is deliberately invalid. Tests compare official CLI catalog and selection results with the MCP transport and test permission, cancellation, replacement and process lifetime separately.
